3. Material V 


Cast Aluminium Pieces — Aluminium alloy casting (see IS : 61* 
Central Spindle and Screws — Mild steel.

(intranet Print^) 

JwriH 


4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 Castings shall be flawless and their outer surfaces machined smooth. 

4.2 The adjustable cast aluminium piece shall be so positioned along the 60 mm threaded length as to 
suit the total forearm length required for the amputee. The extra threaded length shall be cut off before 
moulding the forearm over the metal component. 

5. Marking — Mark with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark. 

5.1 Certification Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

6. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 


♦Specification for adapter for terminal devices, artificial limbs.
